Bruce von Maltitz, chief executive of 1Stream, writes that South Africa currently has no law governing artificial intelligence, and that national rules are expected in 2027.
The Global Center on AI Governance says South Africa has no national AI policy or regulations in place, in a piece published 2026-08-12 that gives no earlier date.
Bowmans partner Melissa Cogger writes that South Africa does not yet have a dedicated AI Act, and that the August 2024 AI Policy Framework is not binding legislation.
